name: Divinare
summary: Mediums guess how many cards of each of four suits will be played each round to score predictions.
rules_text: Divinare is played over 4 rounds with 4 boards, each for a suit. The 36-card deck has 6,8,10,12 cards per suit. Each round shuffle, deal 6 cards to each of 4 players, 12 cards are set aside unseen. Players start prediction tokens on the center of each board. On your turn, play one card face up beside its board, stacking so count is visible, then move your token for that board to any unoccupied numbered space or back to the shared center; you must move. After all have 6, 4, and 2 cards left, each player passes 3,2,1 cards to the right simultaneously before continuing. When all cards are played, each board's exact count determines scoring: exact number = 3 points, adjacent numbers = 1 point, other numbers = -1, center = 0, with 1-2 bonus tokens on marked spaces doubling gain or loss. Highest total after all rounds wins.
rating_reason: deduction of opponents hidden cards with progressive reveal
